The allocation of `mpi_env` in `step_launch.c` ensures that there is a valid memory space for the environment variables to be set, while the improved condition in `env.c` safeguards against errors when accessing this environment variable array. Together, these changes maintain proper PMIx operation and resolve issues introduced by a previous commit, as noted in the patch description.
